# Grant app to organization / member scope
{: .no_toc }

Create an org-wide grant or change who it includes.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `ORG-07` |
| **Route** | `/orgs/:orgId/apps/grant` · deep link `substratal://orgs/:orgId/apps/grant` |
| **Where** | Personal › Organizations |
| **Who can use it** | entitlements.manage or app owner; scope edits by org_admin |
| **Kind** | form |
| **Available in** | All Hub apps (Phase 2) |
| **On Linux** | `AdwDialog` with `AdwPreferencesGroup` |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| App | select | body.application_id | create only | AdwComboRow |
| Who gets access | radio-group | member_scope all_members \ | allowlist \ | GtkCheckButton group |
| Members | member-picker | member_overrides | visible for allowlist/denylist | AdwDialog with GtkSearchEntry list |
| Starts / Ends | date-fields | starts_at, ends_at | optional | GtkCalendar in popover |
| Order ID | text-field | order_id | optional; staff/app owner | AdwEntryRow |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Grant | `POST /organizations/{id}/entitlements (Idempotency-Key)` | 409 entitlement_already_exists → already granted (view it). 422 → field errors. |
| Save scope | `PATCH /entitlements/{id} {member_scope, member_overrides}` |  |
